summary: J.H., 28, of Boulder, took an 80- to 100-foot roped fall while ice climbing the Deep Freeze route above The Loch on Thatchtop Mountain; partner called for help; Flight for Life to St. Anthony's Hospital.
location: Deep Freeze route, above The Loch, Thatchtop Mountain, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: NPS ROMO morning-report compendium entry. Run 713: NPT helicopter-rescues piece describing Heung's 80-100 ft roped fall on Deep Freeze/Thatchtop 2015-03-31 (names her as Janet Heung; parent-verified same incident).
